dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Since she's agreed to join the festival, let's go see who else wants to take part.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lauma's gotta be the person most familiar with the Moon-Prayer Night. We should start with her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, what exactly is your plan to keep her safe?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not sure yet. I'll figure something out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? Are you serious!? And Paimon even gave you her vote of confidence back there... When did you become so sneaky?
